purpose: Seed known archival audio records that can anchor historical events/acoustics. Metadata/reference only until rights are cleared.

archives.institution: NYU Fales Library and Special Collections
archives.collection_note: Peter Dougherty attended CBGB and other downtown clubs from the mid-1970s and recorded shows; the collection contains audio/video/ephemera documenting punk and related scenes.

archives.use_rule: Do not reproduce audio or train/display it in the commercial twin without rights. Catalog records can seed the event graph and rights-acquisition queue. If licensed, original live recordings could later power a historically synchronized performance mode.

future_audio_hunts: former CBGB sound engineer board tapes

acoustic_research_note: Audio recordings alone cannot establish precise room geometry, but once a metric shell exists, multiple known-source recordings may help tune plausible room reverberation/ambience. Never present an inferred acoustic model as measured without impulse-response or equivalent data.
